Title: Retrieve customer appointments with missing required username parameter
Preconditions: User is authenticated and has at least one appointment recorded
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/appointments without the username query parameter.
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the username parameter is required.

Title: Retrieve customer appointments with empty username parameter
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/appointments with the username query parameter set to an empty string.

Test Data: { "username": "" }
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the username parameter cannot be empty.

Title: Unauthorized user attempts to retrieve appointments for another customer
Preconditions: User is authenticated and another customer's username is known
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/appointments with the username query parameter set to another customer's username.

Test Data: { "username": "another_customer@example.com" }
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 403 Forbidden status code with an error message indicating that the user does not have permission to view these appointments.

Title: Update appointment status without required status parameter
Preconditions: User is authenticated, owns the shop, and an appointment exists
Steps: 1. Send a PUT request to /api/shops/{shopId}/appointments/{id} without the status query parameter.
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the status parameter is required.

Title: Unauthorized user attempts to update appointment status for a shop they do not own
Preconditions: User is authenticated, does not own the shop, and an appointment exists
Steps:
1. Send a PUT request to /api/shops/{shopId}/appointments/{id} with the status query parameter set to 'COMPLETED'.

Test Data: { "status": "COMPLETED" }
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 403 Forbidden status code with an error message indicating that the user does not have permission to update appointments for this shop.

Title: Update cash received status for an appointment by unauthorized user
Preconditions: User is authenticated, does not own the shop, and an appointment exists
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 403 Forbidden status code with an error message indicating that the user does not have permission to update this appointment.

Title: Cancel an appointment by unauthorized customer
Preconditions: User is authenticated as a customer, does not own the appointment, and an appointment exists
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 403 Forbidden status code with an error message indicating that the user does not have permission to cancel this appointment.

Title: Retrieve worker list for a shop by unauthorized user
Preconditions: User is authenticated, does not own the shop, and workers exist for the shop
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 403 Forbidden status code with an error message indicating that the user does not have permission to view workers for this shop.

Title: Delete a non-existent service profile
Preconditions: User is authenticated and owns the shop
Steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /api/shops/{shopId}/profiles/{id} with a non-existent service profile ID.
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 404 Not Found status code with an error message indicating that the service profile was not found.

Title: Delete a service profile with mismatched shop ID and service profile ID
Preconditions: User is authenticated, owns the shop, and a service profile exists for another shop
Steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /api/shops/{shopId}/profiles/{id} with a service profile ID that does not belong to the specified shop.
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 403 Forbidden status code with an error message indicating that the service profile does not belong to the specified shop.

Title: Delete a non-existent shop
Preconditions: User is authenticated as an admin
Steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /api/areas/{areaId}/shops/{id} with a non-existent shop ID.
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 404 Not Found status code with an error message indicating that the shop was not found.

Title: Update an area with non-existent ID
Preconditions: User is authenticated and an area exists
Steps:
1. Send a PUT request to /api/areas/{id} with a non-existent area ID and a valid request body.

Test Data: { "name": "Updated Area", "description": "Updated Description" }
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 404 Not Found status code with an error message indicating that the area was not found.

Title: Retrieve an area with non-numeric ID parameter
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/areas/{id} with a non-numeric ID parameter.
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the ID must be a valid number.

Title: Cancel an appointment that is not in PENDING status
Preconditions: User is authenticated, owns the shop, and an appointment exists in COMPLETED status
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the appointment cannot be canceled as it is not in PENDING status.

Title: Update appointment status to an invalid value
Preconditions: User is authenticated, owns the shop, and an appointment exists
Steps:
1. Send a PUT request to /api/shops/{shopId}/appointments/{id} with the status query parameter set to an invalid value (e.g., 'INVALID_STATUS').

Test Data: { "status": "INVALID_STATUS" }
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the status value is invalid.
